wfs52 ns: http://www.xplanung.de/xplangml/5/2

ionsMetadata>

    <FeatureType>

observation.command:
python3 -c "
import re
d=open('/tmp/caps52.xml').read()
i=d.find('<FeatureTypeList>')
seg=d[i:i+400]
ns=re.search(r'xmlns:xplan=\"([^\"]+)\"',seg).group(1)
print('wfs52 ns:',ns)
"
echo "=== wfs40 ns ==="
curl -s -m 40 "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" -o /tmp/caps40.xml
python3 -c "
import re
d=open('/tmp/caps40.xml').read()
i=d.find('BP_AbgrabungsFlaeche')
print(d[i-120:i+60] if i>=0 else 'not found')
"
